reasoning: Started from the approved driver set (Kilian 2026-11-02) and kept every driver unchanged; my own view enters through the leg mix and the scenarios. Alternative-lane evidence: LightCounting via ComSoc (src 8) has the Ethernet optics market +120% in 2026 and +76% in 2027 but warns that 2-3 strong years are often followed by flat/declining ones (a 'bumpy ride' 2027-30), so wireline capture is the swing driver; Advantest (src 15) says AI test demand exceeds supply into CY27 and Anritsu (src 14) plans OP +35% on 800G/1.6T optical test, supporting the FY27 path; supply is the governor (CFO; a single AI-news report of ~$100M slipping, src 10, low confidence); insiders have only sold, mostly on plans (src 17), no signal; retail sentiment peaked 'extremely bullish' in May (src 12) and the stock is down 22% from the Oct 6 high in an AI-hardware/rates selloff (src 11, 22), not on company news. Build EPS ~$16.1 on FY28-weighted NTM is ~12% above MarketScreener FY28 $14.37 and ~20% above Zacks $13.37 (1 est., SBC-expensed) because the approved set is above the Street on revenue (FY28 9,334 vs 8,927) and margin; this is why I put 30% on a mid-cycle 29% margin leg (custom, not driver-linked). Multiple: four whole-company peers median 23.25x, own 23.2x, k=0.8 -> 23.2x; peer count flagged. Base $348 (+14.5%); downside $193 (P10, China -50% shock + optics digestion + margin reset + 17x) and upside $477 (P90), left tail fatter, consistent with 45% realized vol. Research limits: Twelve Data statistics/estimates need a higher plan; X/Reddit not reachable in search results; in-lane share ~45% of sources, the rest being filings and the Street figures the brief requires.

drivers.label: Wireline revenue as a share of the AI-cluster Ethernet optics market
drivers.source: Market: LightCounting AI-cluster Ethernet optics, CY2025 $16.5B (Jan 2026 forecast quoted in POET Technologies FY2025 20-F), +120% 2026 and +76% 2027 (Lightwave 2026-10-08), CY2028 by LightCounting optics/capex ratio x Big-4 capex (Lightwave 2026-03-10; series as gated in driver_models/CRDO/quarterly/set.json optical_tam), CY2029 +27.1% (linear fade of growth from +30.6% in 2028 to LightCounting's +20% by 2031). Wireline: KEYS does not disclose wireline dollars; Q3 FY26 prepared remarks: "Wireline revenue exceeded wireless revenue for the first time this quarter" of commercial communications $1,006M (https://s22.q4cdn.com/444849635/files/doc_earnings/2026/q3/transcript/Q3-FY2026-Prepared-Remarks.pdf); Q3 FY26 call: wireline roughly two-thirds R&D, one-third manufacturing (Motley Fool transcript 2026-08-25).
drivers.derivation: Wireline quarterly estimates (flag: not disclosed): FY25 229/257/290/310 (=1,086; share of CC rising 40->47%, wireline grew double digits FY25 per Q4 FY25 remarks), FY26 358/428/520 (Q3 > wireless 486) and Q4 585 (FY26 1,891). FY growth = 1/3 x market growth (manufacturing test scales with units) + 2/3 x R&D growth (estimate +25% FY27, +15% FY28, +10% FY29; no source, the main judgment): FY27 +42.0% -> 2,685, FY28 +20.2% -> 3,228, FY29 +15.7% -> 3,734. Fiscal FY n paired with CY n (variant: test leads deployment by 2-3 quarters). Quarterly market = log-linear interpolation through each CY midpoint, rescaled so each FY sums to its CY total; forecast wireline quarters grow at one constant quarterly rate per year from the prior quarter so the FY totals hold (FY27 +5.6%/qtr, FY28 +4.2%/qtr, FY29 +3.4%/qtr), capture = wireline / market. Capture FY26 5.21% -> FY27 4.20%, FY28 3.87%, FY29 3.52%. Variant: slower R&D (+15/+10/+5%) gives CC 4,526/5,076/5,571. Supply constrains conversion for several quarters (CFO, Q3 FY26 call).
